text:
Northmere Wind and Solar plc generates electricity from onshore wind, offshore wind and solar sites across the United Kingdom and Ireland. Registered office: Leeds, England. Established 2011.

This is a fictional company and document written for a software test. Any resemblance to a real company is coincidental.
header: [Northmere Wind and Solar plc | p1 | text: Annual Report and Accounts 2025]

text:
Dear shareholders,

2025 was a year of steady delivery. Turnover reached £412 million, an increase of 8.4% on the £380 million recorded in 2024. The board recommends a full-year dividend of 11.2 pence per share, compared with 10.4 pence last year.

Our workforce stands at 1,284 colleagues, up from 1,196 a year earlier. We completed the Kelling Down solar extension on schedule and within budget. The organisation remains committed to its decarbonisation programme and to colour-coded safety reporting at every site.

Eleanor Whitcombe, Chair

text:
For 2026 we expect turnover growth of 6% to 8% and capital investment of about £230 million. We do not plan to acquire any offshore site in 2026; our focus is on raising output from existing sites.
